news.summary: Crude oil prices rose to nearly a one-month high on Thursday morning after President Donald Trump announced the "most crushing economic operation ever undertaken," regarding Iran, in a Wednesday evening Truth Social post.  The Dow industrials, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all opened lower as Treasury yields rebounded.  Beyond the blockade of Iran's Persian Gulf ports, Trump vowed harsh consequences for countries that provide "any type of lifeline to Iran" via government entities, financial institutions, airports, front companies and oil smuggling.
